payload.author: claude
payload.body:
Increment 2 (platform-events) dialect hazards identified before porting — these are NOT driver-translated (the PgSqlDriver only rewrites ?→$n), so portable SQL must be hand-written, matching FR-119-122 conventions:
1. claim() uses INSERT OR IGNORE → rewrite to INSERT ... SELECT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (portable; deliveries unique key is (consumer,event_id)).
2. publish() relies on result.lastInsertRowid for sequence → on PG the driver only surfaces lastInsertRowid from RETURNING id, so change to INSERT ... RETURNING id read via sql.get<{id}>() (node:sqlite supports RETURNING via get/all, per job-store).
3. #findByIdempotencyKey uses 'tenant_id IS ?' (SQLite NULL-safe equality) → PG needs 'tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ?', which SQLite does NOT support. Need a driver-aware predicate or split queries by null/non-null. CHECK how FR-120 identity stores handled NULL-safe matching.
4. claim()/prune() use raw BEGIN IMMEDIATE → SqlDriver.transaction (mind the #txDepth concurrent-nesting note above; claim is serial per worker so OK).

KEY SEQUENCING INSIGHT: platform-events PG correctness is unverifiable until createFrickServer runs on PG. Recommend doing the keystone WIRING (createSqlDriver→PG, async store.initialize() running PG migrations from listen(), driver-aware close, search-adapter selection) with the ALREADY-ported subsystems first, then port platform-events + analytics LAST with a real-PG smoke test (FRICK_DATABASE_URL → docker PG on :5433) to validate each statement. Avoid landing blind dialect ports.
